steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each process's result is matched to its target. A miss of more than 10 percent is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 target missed by more than 10 percent

findings.title: Target missed by more than 10 percent
findings.fix: Set the recovery action for the quarter

findings.title: Next-quarter action with no measure
findings.fix: Add a measure with its target

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] q-returns.md:12  Target missed by more than 10 percent.
       Fix: Set the recovery action for the quarter.
[medium] q-billing.md:19  Process with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
[low] q-changes.md:26  Next-quarter action with no measure.
       Fix: Add a measure with its target.
Not checked: Changes outside the reports.
pros: Checks a target missed by more than 10 percent, a process with no owner, and a next-quarter action with no measure.
cons: Not checked: Changes outside the reports.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ops-quarterly-process-review skill on the records for this review.
